ucs.title: [LLM] Gamaredon (Shuckworm/Aqua Blizzard) maldoc template-injection → mshta/wscript downloader chain
ucs.description: Hunts Gamaredon's signature delivery-to-execution chain where a spearphished Office document (T1566.001) with a remote template (T1221) spawns mshta.exe or the Windows script host to pull and run a downloader, the group's most consistent first-stage tradecraft against Ukrainian targets.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","cmd.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval suspicious_cmd=if(match(lower(process),"http|\.ru|ddns|\.hta|mshta|getobject|createobject|downloadstring|frombase64|-enc|iex|wscript\.shell"),1,0)
| where suspicious_cmd=1 OR process_name IN ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name process_name process parent_process
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend CmdLower = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| where FileName in~ ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
      or CmdLower has_any ("http",".ru","ddns",".hta","getobject","createobject","downloadstring","frombase64","-enc","iex","invoke-expression","wscript.shell")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe")
| where ActingProcessName has_any ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| extend CmdLower = tolower(ActingProcessCommandLine)
| where ActingProcessName has_any ("mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
      or CmdLower has_any ("http",".ru","ddns",".hta","getobject","createobject","downloadstring","frombase64","-enc","iex","invoke-expression","wscript.shell")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentProcessName,
          ParentProcessCommandLine, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Office Application Spawns Script Host or Mshta Downloader (Gamaredon)
id: 4b1f7c2e-9a3d-4e21-8c77-9d2f0a1b6e34
status: experimental
description: Detects an Office process spawning mshta/wscript/cscript/powershell with download indicators, matching Gamaredon template-injection delivery.
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate document automation / macro-enabled templates
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1221
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.t1566.001
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\WINWORD.EXE OR *\winword.exe OR *\EXCEL.EXE OR *\excel.exe OR *\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\powerpnt.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\outlook.exe) @Image:(*\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook)\.exe/i
| ImageFileName=/(mshta|wscript|cscript|powershell|cmd)\.exe/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Gamaredon overwhelmingly relies on Office-delivered remote-template maldocs that immediately hand off to mshta/wscript downloaders — an Office parent spawning a script host or mshta is rare in benign telemetry and is the specific delivery→execution hinge documented across ESET, Symantec (Shuckworm) and Microsoft (ACTINIUM/Aqua Blizzard) reporting, distinguishing it from generic phishing-macro temp

ucs.title: [LLM] Gamaredon (Shuckworm) USB/share self-propagation via wscript dropping LNK lures (PteroLNK)
ucs.description: Hunts Gamaredon's distinctive worming behavior where a VBS run by wscript/cscript writes shortcut (.lnk) decoys mimicking folders onto removable drives and network shares, the PteroLNK propagation routine that is a near-unique Shuckworm signature.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.process_name IN ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe")) AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.lnk") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| rex field=file_path "^(?<drive>[A-Za-z]:)\\\\"
| eval removable_or_root=if(match(file_path,"^[D-Zd-z]:\\\\") OR match(file_path,"^\\\\\\\\"),1,0)
| stats count dc(file_path) as lnk_paths values(file_path) as paths min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by dest user process_name
| where lnk_paths >= 3 OR count >= 5
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| table firstTime lastTime dest user process_name lnk_paths paths
ucs.kql:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe")
| where FileName endswith ".lnk"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| extend DriveLetter = tostring(extract(@"^([A-Za-z]):\\", 1, FolderPath))
| extend IsRemovableOrShare = (FolderPath startswith @"\\") or (isnotempty(DriveLetter) and DriveLetter !in~ ("C"))
| summarize LnkPaths = dcount(FolderPath), Total = count(),
            Paths = make_set(FolderPath, 20),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
          by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, IsRemovableOrShare
| where LnkPaths >= 3 or Total >= 5     // 3+ distinct .lnk drops = fan-out, not a user shortcut
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventType == "FileCreated"
| where ActingProcessName has_any ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe")
| where TargetFileName endswith ".lnk"
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| extend DriveLetter = tostring(extract(@"^([A-Za-z]):\\", 1, TargetFilePath))
| extend IsRemovableOrShare = (TargetFilePath startswith @"\\") or (isnotempty(DriveLetter) and DriveLetter !in~ ("C"))
| summarize LnkPaths = dcount(TargetFilePath), Total = count(),
            Paths = make_set(TargetFilePath, 20),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
          by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, IsRemovableOrShare
| where LnkPaths >= 3 or Total >= 5
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Script Host Writes Shortcut Files to Drive Roots or Shares (Gamaredon PteroLNK)
id: 7c2a91d4-3e58-4b0f-9a16-2d8b4f1c0a77
status: experimental
description: Detects wscript/cscript/mshta creating .lnk files, the PteroLNK USB/share self-propagation routine used by Gamaredon (Shuckworm).
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.lnk'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Logon scripts or deployment tooling that generates shortcuts
level: high
tags:
  - attack.lateral-movement
  - attack.t1091
  - attack.t1059.005
  - attack.t1036.005
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 @Image:(*\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE) @TargetFilename:(*.lnk OR *.LNK)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten ContextImageFileName=/(wscript|cscript|mshta)\.exe/i
| TargetFileName=/\.lnk$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName], function={ count(field=TargetFileName, distinct=true, as=lnk_paths) | count(as=total) })
| lnk_paths >= 3
ucs.rationale: Aggressive USB and network-share self-propagation by dropping LNK decoys (PteroLNK) is one of the few behaviors that distinctly fingerprints Gamaredon/Shuckworm versus other Russian espionage actors (per Symantec Jan 2022 and ESET reporting). Keying on a script host fanning out .lnk files across drive roots/shares — rather than a generic single LNK creation — ties the detection to the group's worm
